topic: Introduce a Chinese Coming-of-Age Ceremony(介绍一种中国成人礼)
title_en: An Introduction to a Chinese Coming-of-Age Ceremony
genre: 说明文 / 介绍(write a unified paragraph introducing a Chinese coming-of-age ceremony)
source: 上外版必修第一册 Unit 4 Moving Forward:Writing an introduction to a coming-of-age ceremony in China(60-80词,主题句+支撑句+结尾句,保持段落统一)。
prompt_cn: 你校正在举办成人礼,一群来自美国高中的学生前来参观。请你用英语写一段约80词的介绍,向美国学生介绍一种中国的成人礼(如古代的笄礼或冠礼),内容包括:① 它在什么时候、为谁举行;② 主要的庆祝活动或环节;③ 它的意义。注意:用一个主题句开头,支撑句围绕中心,用一个结尾句收束,保持段落统一。
prompt_en: Your school is holding a coming-of-age ceremony, and a group of American high-school students are coming to visit. Write a paragraph of about 80 words to introduce one Chinese coming-of-age ceremony (such as the ancient hair-pinning or capping ceremony) to them. Include: 1) when and for whom it is held; 2) the main activities; 3) its meaning. Begin with a topic sentence, keep all supporting sentences on one idea, and finish with a concluding sentence.
points: 主题句:点明这是中国一种成人礼(In ancient China, … was held to mark …)
时间与对象(It was held for … when they were … years old)
主要环节/活动(During the ceremony, …)
意义 + 结尾句(It showed that … / It reminded young people that …)
model_essay: In ancient China, the hair-pinning ceremony was a coming-of-age ceremony held to mark an important moment in a girl's life. It was performed when she was fifteen years old. During the ceremony, the girl would wash and comb her hair, and then a ceremony master would carefully put a pin in it. This showed everyone that she was no longer a child. The custom reminded young people that, as adults, they should respect their parents and shoulder real responsibilities. In short, it was a meaningful way to welcome a new stage of life.
model_translation: 在古代中国,笄礼是一种成人礼,用来标志女孩生命中的一个重要时刻。它在女孩十五岁时举行。仪式上,女孩会梳洗头发,然后由一位仪式主持人小心地为她插上发笄。这向所有人表明她不再是个孩子。这一习俗提醒年轻人:作为成年人,他们应当尊重父母、承担真正的责任。总之,这是迎接人生新阶段的一种有意义的方式。

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:何时为谁举行 / 主要环节 / 意义
主题句开头、支撑句围绕一个中心、结尾句回扣、段落统一
句型词汇准确多样、被动语态等运用得当、语法基本无误

required_structure: 主题句 In ancient China, … was held to mark …
时间对象 It was performed when …
意义/结尾 The custom reminded young people that … / In short, …
key_expressions: In ancient China, the hair-pinning ceremony was held to mark an important moment.
It was performed when she was fifteen years old.
During the ceremony, a master would put a pin in her hair.
It reminded young people that they should shoulder real responsibilities.

high_sentences: In ancient China, the hair-pinning ceremony was held to mark an important moment in a girl's life.
It was performed when she was fifteen years old.
This showed everyone that she was no longer a child.
The custom reminded young people that they should shoulder real responsibilities.

error_pairs.wrong: The ceremony was hold when she was fifteen.
error_pairs.correct: The ceremony was held when she was fifteen.
error_pairs.note: 被动语态用过去分词 held,不是 hold。

error_pairs.wrong: A pin was put in her hair by a master carefully.
error_pairs.correct: A master carefully put a pin in her hair.
error_pairs.note: 有明确施动者且要强调动作时,主动更自然;副词位置也要恰当。

error_pairs.wrong: It reminded young people they should respect parents.
error_pairs.correct: It reminded young people that they should respect their parents.
error_pairs.note: remind sb that … 引导宾语从句,that 不宜省、需用 their。

paragraph_template:
【成人礼介绍结构】
第1句 主题句:In ancient China, … was held to mark …
第2句 时间对象:It was performed when …
第3-4句 环节:During the ceremony, … This showed that …
第5句 意义/结尾:The custom reminded young people that … / In short, …
